description: This file defines a PHP class 'Order' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Sale' namespace. It handles administrative order-related functionalities such as listing orders, viewing order details, and filtering orders based on various criteria. The class extends a core controller and contains methods for loading order lists, generating links with filters, and rendering views. The file appears to be part of the backend controller components of an OpenCart e-commerce platform.
